item.title: Teachers and educational transformation in the age of AI
item.description: An interview on the changing responsibilities of educators when AI can produce convincing academic work. It distinguishes the quality of a learning product from the learner’s independent understanding and highlights the importance of thoughtful instructional design and human relationships.

item.title: Specialised schools as institutions for discovering and developing talent
item.description: Discussing proposed reforms, Đặng Minh Tuấn distinguishes rehearsed examination performance from developmental potential. He supports broader admissions pathways, exploration before specialisation and research-oriented learning, while cautioning against overlooking exceptional subject-specific talent.

item.title: Introducing AI into schools: Learning to use and verify it
item.description: VOV1's current-affairs programme addresses the tension between the convenience of AI-generated explanations and students' ability to recognise errors. Its introduction identifies independent learning and thinking as central considerations in school AI integration. Dr Tuan Minh Dang of VNU University of Education is the featured guest.

item.title: An initial AI literacy framework for school students: International review and implications for Vietnam
item.description: The article addresses AI literacy for school students through an international review and considers adaptation to the Vietnamese educational context. The publisher’s issue listing confirms the title and authorship; the abstract could not be retrieved in this verification session.

item.title: Rethinking digital competence for pre-service teachers in the GenAI era: A conceptual framework for pedagogical GenAI judgment
item.description: The conceptual article proposes DigiGen-PST 2030, placing pedagogical GenAI judgment within a wider framework of digital competence, pedagogical transformation and future-oriented skills. It compares existing teacher technology and AI competency frameworks to clarify what prospective teachers need to decide and evaluate when using generative AI.

item.title: Designing GenAI-supported learning activities in teacher education: Cognitive effort, pedagogical judgment and academic integrity
item.description: A design-oriented theoretical review integrates selected research in cognition, learning sciences and teacher education with Vietnamese policy documents. It proposes seven points of pedagogical control and argues that using GenAI effectively depends on how tasks, assistance and evidence of reasoning are organised.

item.title: Ages 11–15: An appropriate period for gifted and specialised education
item.description: Responding to Hanoi's proposal to invest in specialised lower-secondary schools, Đặng Minh Tuấn argues that ages 11–15 are appropriate for nurturing talent as logical thinking and learning interests emerge.

item.title: Grade 10 admissions: Looking beyond the specialised versus mainstream school distinction
item.description: In a VOV report, Đặng Minh Tuấn emphasises that the Grade 10 entrance examination is important but does not determine a student's future. Families should select an educational environment that matches the learner's abilities and interests, rather than prioritising the specialised-school label.

item.title: Integrating educational robotics into the training program for developing students’ ICT competence in teaching
item.description: This book chapter describes a teacher-education curriculum at VNU University of Education that uses educational robotics to develop future natural science teachers’ ICT competence. Illustrative science experiments connect sensors, mobile devices and constructivist instructional approaches.

item.title: Fostering STEM Education Competency for Elementary Education Students at Universities of Pedagogy in Vietnam
item.description: Using questionnaires and interviews with final-year primary-education students in Vietnam, the study reports moderate overall STEM teaching competence, with some components below that level. It identifies training content and instructional organisation as concerns and proposes improvements to technology-supported preparation.

item.title: Training Elementary Teachers in Vietnam by Blended Learning Model
item.description: The study examines how lecturers in Vietnamese primary teacher-education programmes view the balance between face-to-face and online instruction. Questionnaire and interview responses reveal differing preferences and emphasise technological conditions and participants’ digital skills.

item.title: Racing to prepare young children for IELTS and TOEFL: A misplaced educational priority
item.description: In this VOV2 interview, Đặng Minh Tuấn distinguishes the value of foreign-language proficiency from its use as a proxy for talent. He questions early certificate preparation when admissions incentives divert time and resources from other areas of development.

item.title: Vietnam's first participation in the International Philosophy Olympiad (IPO)
item.description: VOV2 reports on Vietnam's debut at the International Philosophy Olympiad in Olympia, Greece, in May 2023. The two-student delegation, led by Đặng Minh Tuấn of VNU University of Education, achieved an Honorable Mention through Phạm Bùi Gia Khanh.
